_comment: Model ladder for the Jev write-up, pinned by Hugging Face repo revision and file size (from the HF API, blobs=true, 2026-09-20). transformers.js fetches exactly the files listed here at that revision and keeps them in the Cache API under 'transformers-cache', so a rung's URLs (engine/models.js fileUrls) double as its cache keys. The heads in data/ were trained on the Python side with the same models, so a rung and its head travel together.

engine.name: transformers.js
engine._comment: the worker import()s this URL; the ONNX runtime wasm comes from the same package's dist/ (transformers.js's default)

rungs.head: data/head.bge-small.json?v=8ee67d2c3612bfccb49e
rungs.note: the arrival model: the head in the article was trained on this one
rungs._sectionSimNote: cosine floor for the section slot, measured 2026-09-20: bge scores unrelated text 0.55-0.67 and near-misses up to 0.74 ('highlight laya' vs 'von laya decider'); real section phrasings 0.80-0.92

speech.note: local speech with Silero voice activity detection; automatically preloaded when no working browser speech service is known; microphone starts only on click
